items.label: God run  [F5]
items.desc: God mode + infinite ammo + infinite magazine + no damage + Action Skill always ready. Press again to undo.  Other hotkeys: F6 kill 80 m, F7 loot vacuum, F9 teleport to map pin, Ctrl+F9 save position, Shift+F9 go back.

items.label: Loot farm  [F11]
items.desc: Gear luck 500, XP x5, cash x5, enemy health x0.05.

items.label: God mode
items.desc: The game's own god lock (OakDamageStatics::SetGodLock). Re-applied after map changes.

items.label: Invisible to enemies
items.desc: Enemies treat you as friendly and stop attacking - good for watching spawns, wars and bosses. Your allies still fight. Off = back to normal.

items.label: Set character level
items.desc: The game's own BP_SetExperienceLevel: stats scale and skill points follow.

items.label: Infinite reserve ammo
items.desc: The game's own InfiniteAmmoLock.

items.label: Damage multiplier
items.desc: damage_dealt_multiplier through the game's attribute modifiers.

items.label: Instant reload
items.desc: On: reloads finish almost at once. Off: normal reload. The speed slider below and this switch share one setting - the last one you use wins.

items.label: Reload speed x
items.desc: 1 = normal, 2 = twice as fast, 10 = ten times as fast. Works on every gun and is kept after map changes.

items.label: Infinite magazine (no reloading)
items.desc: weapon_shot_cost 0: shots cost no ammo. Verified in game.

items.label: Remove every stat change (back to normal)
Fast cooldown
items.desc: Cooldown refills at the speed set below (default 4x).

items.label: Cooldown speed x
items.desc: 1 = normal, 4 = four times as fast. Moving it switches Fast cooldown on. (No cooldown above makes it instant.)

items.label: Skill points earned - set to
items.desc: Counts every point you have earned, spent ones included. Raising it gives you that many more unspent points; the Skills menu shows them at once.
Refunds every point spent in your skill trees right away. Open the skill menu and spend them again.
items.label: Respec skill trees (refund every spent point)

items.text: Added points and the skills you put them into are kept by the trainer: the game drops spends above your level when it saves or loads, and the trainer spends them again a second after you load in. Without the trainer the save shows a normal tree for your level.

items.label: SDU tokens earned - set to
items.desc: Counts every token you have earned, spent ones included. Raising it gives you that many more to spend in the SDU menu. Shared by all your characters; the game saves it itself.
Refunds every SDU token right away. Buy the upgrades again in the SDU menu.
items.label: Respec SDU upgrades (refund every spent token)

items.text: SDU tokens upgrade ammo, backpack, bank and lost loot space. Open the SDU menu to spend them.

items.desc: Refunds every specialization token right away.
items.label: Respec specializations
Infinite jump (double jump without limit)
items.desc: Keep pressing jump in the air to keep going up.

items.label: Game speed
items.desc: 1 = normal, below 1 = slow motion.

items.desc: Open the list and start typing - it narrows down as you type (in-game or Gearbox names). Enter takes the first match; a name not in the list is tried as typed. Boss / DLC-only legendaries are made in Gear Maker.

items.label: Bring all loot within 60 m to me
Save every item code (serials.txt)
items.desc: Backpack, equipped, bank and ground items -> serials.txt in the trainer folder (codes save editors use).

items.label: Weapon type
items.desc: Who makes what: Assault rifle: Daedalus, Jakobs, Order, Tediore, Torgue, Vladof  Pistol: Daedalus, Jakobs, Order, Tediore, Torgue  Shotgun: Ripper, Daedalus, Jakobs, Maliwan, Tediore, Torgue  SMG: Ripper, Daedalus, Maliwan, Vladof  Sniper rifle: Ripper, Jakobs, Maliwan, Order, Vladof  Heavy weapon: Ripper, Maliwan, Torgue, Vladof

items.label: Rarity
items.desc: Common..Epic: rolled from the maker's own pool until the rarity matches. Legendary: one of that maker+type's named legendaries. Pearl: the type's pearl pool.

items.label: Or a named legendary

options.label: Bonnie And Clyde (BonnieClyde)  -  Jakobs Assault rifle
Potato Thrower Iv (PotatoThrower)  -  Torgue Assault rifle

items.desc: Overrides the choices above. 156 legendaries.

items.label: BUILD (drops in front of you)
items.desc: The game's own loot generation picks the parts. Real item, keeps after save. Named legendaries only drop from about level 15: below that the builder raises the level by itself and tells you.

items.label: Stop the running build
items.desc: Cancels a build that is still re-rolling.

items.label: Magazine size
items.desc: Verified: 4 -> 50 after a reload.

items.label: Difficulty preset
items.desc: Ordered from ridiculously easy to WHAT THE ACTUAL HELL. Sets every slider below; change any slider afterwards for your own mix.

items.label: Surprise me (random hard mix + funny name)
items.desc: Picks a random level 7-13 mix, shakes the numbers and gives it a random name.

items.label: Back to the game's normal difficulty
items.desc: Removes every enemy tweak (live enemies go back to normal within a second).

items.label: Enemy health, shields & armor x
items.desc: Every health bar of each enemy (flesh, shield, armor). Fresh enemies start full.

items.label: Enemy damage x
items.desc: How hard enemies hit (their damage_dealt_multiplier).

items.label: Enemy move speed x
items.desc: How fast enemies run.

items.label: Enemy reflexes (their whole clock) x
items.desc: Speeds up or slows down everything an enemy does: attacks, reactions, animations. Above 1.3 gets silly.

items.label: Enemy aim accuracy x
items.desc: Gun enemies only: how well they aim.

items.label: Enemy fire rate x
items.desc: Gun enemies only: how fast they shoot.

items.label: Enemies use guns from your backpack %
items.desc: Chance a gun enemy is handed a random weapon from your backpack (legendaries included) - build a weapon, then watch them use it.

items.label: World spawn amount x (the game's own spawner)
items.desc: The game's spawn director budget (gbx.Spawn.BudgetScale): areas fill with more (or fewer) real camps and herds, placed by the game itself. Takes effect as areas load - leave and come back. Tested: x1 = 7-10 enemies at a camp, x5 = 22-33.

items.label: Extra enemies per enemy
items.desc: Each new enemy brings this many friends (0.5 = half the time one more). Max 40 extra a minute. Bosses are never copied.

items.label: Badass upgrade chance %
items.desc: Chance an extra enemy is the Badass version (when the game has one).

items.label: Boss ambush every N minutes (0 = off)
items.desc: A random boss (replay / rift bosses) shows up in front of you every N minutes - only out in the world, not in town.

items.label: Spawn a random boss now
items.desc: 18 m in front of you. Uses the current enemy health/damage settings.

items.label: Spawn a boss by name (e.g. CrazyEarl, Icemaw)
items.desc: Part of the character name. BL.DIFF {bosses:true} lists the boss names.

items.label: Extra gun drop chance %
items.desc: On every kill: chance of one extra gun.

items.label: Extra legendary drop chance %
items.desc: On every kill: chance of a legendary (x5 on bosses).

items.text: More XP / cash: Money tab (Combat XP x, Cash pickups x).

items.label: Spawn character (name or part, e.g. Psycho)
items.desc: 1883 spawnable characters in actors.json. Spawned 8 m in front.

items.label: Show enemy info + loot on screen
Teleport to my map pin  [F9]
items.desc: Open the map (M), right-click a spot = Custom Pin.

items.label: Console command / cvar
items.desc: Runs one of the game's console commands.

items.label: Matrix look on / off
items.desc: Green Matrix colours and code rain on the screen. Only a screen effect: it works in first person, third person (Third person section) and the free camera. Bullet time is its own switch below.

items.label: Bullet time on / off
items.desc: The world runs in slow motion while you keep your normal speed. Works with or without the Matrix look, in any camera view.

items.label: World speed in bullet time
items.desc: 0.2 = the world at 20% speed. You stay at normal speed.

items.label: Green Matrix tint on / off
items.desc: The green colour grade of the Matrix view.

items.label: Code rain on / off
items.desc: Green Matrix code raining down the screen while the Matrix view is on.

items.label: Code rain amount
items.desc: 1.3 = a full Matrix screen. Below 1 = fewer columns, above 1 = several streams per column (code storm).

items.label: Code rain speed
items.desc: How fast the code falls.

items.label: Code rain strength
items.desc: How strongly the rain covers the game picture.

items.label: Code rain glyph size
items.desc: Size of the falling characters (scaled up automatically above 1080p).

items.label: Free camera on / off
items.desc: Fly the camera anywhere: mouse looks, W/A/S/D moves, Space up, C down, Shift fast. Your character stays where it is.

items.label: Free camera speed x
items.desc: How fast the free camera flies.

items.label: Freeze the world (photo pause)
items.desc: Stops the world clock - bullets, enemies, effects hang in the air. The free camera still moves. Press again to unfreeze.

items.label: Hide / show the HUD
items.desc: Clean screenshots: hides the game HUD.

items.label: Third person on / off
items.desc: The game's own third-person camera, moved over your shoulder so the crosshair sits on open ground. Shots go where the crosshair points.

items.label: Swap shoulder
items.desc: Right <-> left shoulder. While aiming in third person: click the left stick (L3) or the middle mouse button. The side you pick is remembered.

items.label: Camera distance (cm)
items.desc: How far behind you the camera sits. The game's default is 256.

items.label: Shoulder offset (cm)
items.desc: 0 = straight behind you (the character covers the crosshair).

items.label: Camera height (cm)
items.desc: Up / down from eye level.

items.label: Pick-up aim distance (cm)
items.desc: The camera turns slightly inward so the crosshair and your character's 'use' line meet this far ahead - items, chests and doors under the crosshair can be picked up / opened.

items.label: Aim zoom (mouse or gamepad)
items.desc: While you aim (right mouse or left trigger) the camera pulls in over the shoulder, zooms, and shows an aim reticle.

items.label: Aim: camera distance (cm)
items.desc: Camera distance while aiming.

items.label: Aim: shoulder offset (cm)
items.desc: Shoulder offset while aiming.

items.label: Aim: field of view
items.desc: Lower = more zoom while aiming.

items.label: First person (normal)
items.desc: The game's normal camera.

items.label: Orbit / side camera
items.desc: The game's orbit camera mode (used by some skills).

items.label: Field of view (0 = game setting)
items.desc: Wider or narrower view without touching your game settings. 0 = use the game's own FOV.

items.label: Reset camera
items.desc: Back to first person, HUD on, normal FOV, world unfrozen, free camera off.

items.label: Loot luck (better rarity)
items.desc: Att_Luck_Gear: the game's own gear-luck attribute used by loot rolls.

items.label: Vault Card 2: +10 tokens
items.desc: Adds 10 Vault Card 2 tokens - spend them in the game's Vault Card menu. Works on any Vault Card that is active on this character.

items.label: Vault Card 2: set level
items.desc: Sets Vault Card 2 to the level you type.

items.label: SDU tokens - set to
items.desc: SDU tokens are shared by all your characters; the game saves the new amount itself.
Refunds every point spent in your skill trees right away. Open the skill menu and spend them again.
items.label: Respec skill trees (refund every spent point)

items.desc: Refunds every specialization token right away.
items.label: Respec specializations

items.text: Skill points come from your level - raise it on the Player tab (Set level). Respec gives every spent point back.

sections.name: Save editor (applies when the game starts)

items.text: The game only reads your save when it starts. Queue changes here, then press Apply & close (the game saves and closes; start it again from Steam and the changes are written before it loads your save).

items.label: Add items by serial (paste one or many)
items.desc: Item codes start with @U. Several can be pasted at once, separated by spaces.

items.label: UVH level (experimental)
items.desc: Writes the Ultimate Vault Hunter level fields used by earlier saves; not verified on the current game version.

items.label: Apply & close the game
items.desc: Closes the game like the X button. Start it again from Steam: the trainer writes the queued changes before the game reads the save (a backup of the save is kept in save_backups).

sections.name: Pause trainer jobs one at a time (move around and feel the difference)

items.label: Resume everything
items.desc: Turns every job below back on.

items.label: Pause ALL trainer jobs
items.desc: Stops every background job at once (the overlay itself keeps running). Use Resume everything to undo.

items.label: Pause / resume: Panel readouts
items.desc: Reads the numbers shown in the panel (health, level...) once a second. A message at the top of the screen says what is paused.

items.label: Pause / resume: Loot jobs
items.desc: Auto pick-up / loot magnet. A message at the top of the screen says what is paused.

items.label: Pause / resume: Enemy HUD / loot radar
items.desc: Collects the on-screen enemy and loot labels. A message at the top of the screen says what is paused.

items.label: Pause / resume: Weapon builder
items.desc: Finishes weapon-builder jobs. A message at the top of the screen says what is paused.

items.label: Pause / resume: Difficulty
items.desc: Difficulty tweaks + spawn budget check. A message at the top of the screen says what is paused.

items.label: Pause / resume: Enemies / spawn swap / territories
items.desc: Spawn jobs, spawn swap and the territory learning. A message at the top of the screen says what is paused.

items.label: Pause / resume: Camera (third person, Matrix, free cam, FOV)
items.desc: Every camera feature, including third-person aim. A message at the top of the screen says what is paused.

items.label: Pause / resume: Stat modifiers
items.desc: Re-applies your stat changes after a respawn / zone change. A message at the top of the screen says what is paused.

items.label: Pause / resume: Saved toggles (inf ammo, no cooldown...)
items.desc: Re-applies the toggles you switched on, every 0.5 s. A message at the top of the screen says what is paused.

items.label: Pause / resume: Trainer hotkeys
items.desc: Watches the trainer hotkeys (F3, F4, Ctrl+F4...). A message at the top of the screen says what is paused.

items.label: Pause / resume: Panel file watcher
items.desc: Reloads panel.json / api.json when they change. A message at the top of the screen says what is paused.
